recipes.title: Butternut Squash Cottage Cheese Pasta

items.i: pasta water, plus more as needed

steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the squash with olive oil, salt and pepper and roast 25–30 minutes until tender.
Cook the rigatoni per the package, reserving pasta water before draining.
Blend the roasted squash, cottage cheese, garlic, milk, Dijon, cinnamon, salt, pepper and a drizzle of olive oil until smooth, adding pasta water as needed.
Warm the sauce in a skillet over medium-low with about ½ cup pasta water until smooth, then toss with the rigatoni.
Top with Parmesan and fresh sage.
recipes.notes: Ingredients, steps and calories are the creator's; she only lists calories, so protein, carbs and fat are my estimate. Go easy on the cinnamon; too much overpowers the sauce.
